title: Anonymous tourism saturday newsletter win

change.control: Send the monthly promotional newsletter on Monday.
change.variant: Send the same monthly promotional newsletter on Saturday.

significance.reported: 99% level of confidence for Saturday versus Monday open rate.

quote: Saturday had the highest performing day with 5.5% relative difference with a 99% Level of Confidence (LOC).
notes: One arm versus Monday in the seven-day newsletter experiment. Clickthrough, a secondary metric, was not significant; its Saturday comparison had 88% confidence. Do not present this as a purchase or clickthrough win.
